daily.brief: 過去兩日（11月21日晚至23日凌晨）125個帳號發了371則帖，記憶體相關的$SKHY同$META出現明確共同看好，而最熱鬧的$NVDA則多空拉扯，提及次數高達82次。最大變化係VIX衝上40，市場波動預期升溫，有人視作買入機會，有人則對高beta組合保持警惕。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好集中在$SKHY。@TrendSpider指出RSI在歷史低位出現看漲背離（原帖），@Biotech2k1直言偏好SKHY勝過沒有HBM的SNDK（原帖），@Beth_Kindig則提到HBM4晶片良率已超70%，第三季將全面量產出貨（原帖）。$META也有三位帳號同向：@OptionsMike睇540-520區域作入場（原帖），@JasonL_Capital強調成長股估值已變便宜，NVDA遠期只剩8倍（原帖），@TheTranscript_引述Meta總裁稱Zuckerberg已親自搬進AI實驗室寫產品（原帖）。

共同看淡

$MSTR是少數純粹看淡的標的。@PeterSchiff直指風險披露無用，這類廣告會成為崩盤時被起訴的原因（原帖），@zeroshorts只回「思想和祈禱。哈哈。」（原帖），@capitalflows則用相關性工具顯示包含MSTR的高beta組合在下跌日平均損失大於SPY（原帖）。

分歧

分歧最大的是$NVDA，82則提及中多空帳號幾乎對半。@MrMikeInvesting問遠期8倍、股價127是否強力買入，並列出營收同比增103%、EPS增106%等數字（原帖）；@MarketRebels引述VIX觸及40、高於32意味每日波動預期達2%，極端恐懼時反而是買入時機（原帖）；@JerryCap則詢問周一是否會漲停，並引述對Alice Huang事件的解讀（原帖）。有人覺得估值已極具吸引力，有人仍擔心近期回撤與波動。

其他值得留意

@OptionsMike也提到$AMZN顯示相對強度，仍在6個月通道內並守住200日均線（原帖）。VIX衝上40是這段期間最明顯的市場情緒變化。

今日簡報

過去兩日市場討論集中在波動升溫與個別供應鏈名稱。SKHY因HBM4良率超70%與技術背離獲3個帳號共同看好，META則有帳號點出540-520入場區。MSTR維持純粹看淡。NVDA以82則提及成為焦點，有人強調遠期8倍估值，有人則關注VIX已觸及40帶來的波動預期。所有數字均來自指定期間計算結果，未加入額外資訊。

daily.brief: Over the past two days (from the evening of Nov 21 to early morning of Nov 23), 125 accounts posted 371 times. Memory-related $SKHY and $META saw clear shared bullish views, while the most discussed $NVDA remained split with 82 mentions. The biggest shift was VIX hitting 40, raising volatility expectations that some treat as a buying signal and others as a warning for high-beta baskets.
daily.full:
Consensus

Shared bullish views concentrated on $SKHY. @TrendSpider noted RSI bullish divergence at historic lows (post), @Biotech2k1 preferred SKHY over SNDK because the latter lacks HBM (post), and @Beth_Kindig reported HBM4 chip yields above 70% with full-scale production and shipments starting in Q3 (post). $META also had three accounts aligned: @OptionsMike looking at the 540-520 zone for entry (post), @JasonL_Capital highlighting that growth stocks have become cheap with NVDA at 8x forward (post), and @TheTranscript_ quoting Meta’s president that Zuckerberg has moved into the AI lab to write products himself (post).

Shared Bearish

$MSTR was one of the few pure bearish names. @PeterSchiff said risk disclosures won’t protect and such ads will be why people get sued when the scheme collapses (post), @zeroshorts replied “thoughts and prayers. haha.” (post), and @capitalflows showed that high-beta baskets including MSTR lose more than SPY on down days on average (post).

Split

The largest split was on $NVDA, with bullish and bearish accounts nearly even among 82 mentions. @MrMikeInvesting asked whether 8x forward and the $127 level is a strong buy, citing 103% YoY revenue growth and 106% EPS growth (post); @MarketRebels noted VIX hitting 40 and that levels above 32 imply 2% daily moves, with extreme fear often a buying opportunity (post); @JerryCap asked if it would limit-up on Monday and discussed the Alice Huang episode (post). Some see the valuation as highly attractive while others remain wary of the recent drawdown and volatility.

Other Notable

@OptionsMike also pointed out relative strength in $AMZN, still inside its 6-month channel and holding the 200-day moving average (post). VIX reaching 40 was the clearest sentiment shift in the window.
